verdict.rationale: Copilot exposes some programmatic surfaces—a documented CLI (github-copilot-probe-4), MCP server integration for extending Copilot Chat (github-copilot-docs-20, -21), and automation/agent APIs for cloud agents (github-copilot-docs-15)—but there is no evidence of a comprehensive, publicly documented REST/OpenAPI API for driving Copilot itself; explicit OpenAPI/swagger probes all 404'd (github-copilot-probe-3).
